Depth printed 1.57 (bottom chord to apex) with 0.87 at the outer panel posts. Sections A/B print ระดับหลังอะเส +4.70 to ระดับหลังอกไก่ +6.12 = 1.42 — the 1.57 here is the truss's own dimension line (to the top of the tube/roof line), kept as printed; the two are different dimension lines, not a conflict resolved either way.
The อะเส leader (2C-150x50x20x2.3) points to the end supports; the อะเส spec is recorded once, in the TRUSS T2 file of this sheet. 'T2' is printed at the king post (where the ridge truss T2 crosses).
